title: Webb County Constable Precinct 1 Joins Community at 45th Annual Guajolote 5K and 10K on Thanksgiving Morning
excerpt: Webb County Constable Precinct 1 Guadalupe Gomez and his deputies joined the community at the 45th Annual Guajolote 5K and 10K Run on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.
content:
Webb County Constable Precinct 1 Guadalupe Gomez and his deputies joined the community at the 45th Annual Guajolote 5K & 10K Run on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

The run is a Thanksgiving morning tradition in Laredo, and this year's event drew a great turnout with great energy, according to the Constable's Office.

Sources: Webb County Constable Precinct 1, Nov. 26, 2026.
